Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
Pablo Alonso <pal...@mail.ono.es> wrote:
>> He's a 2-capacity, since the discpline cards are out of play.
>
> Out of play means that these cards are burned? Or they remain on the
> vampire untill he leaves uncontrolled region?

All minion cards, master cards, counters on said cards and any other
game states on the vampire, regardless of controller, also go to the
uncontrolled region with the vampire, cannot be contested and will not
take effect again until the vampire comes back to the active region.
When the vampire returns, everything is back the way it was, including
who controls the cards played on it.

Note that cards that merely point to a vampire (i.e., The Rack) do not
follow the vampire to the uncontrolled region and can be contested. Also
note that a Vampire that has had a change of political title (either
gained or lost one) before it was Banished will still have that change
of title in effect when it returns.

In essence, as above, so below, so above again.
